disposition_mapping.rationale: Extraction of locked-period actuals is folded into a single automated extraction-and-load step alongside comparatives loading, but the requirement to consume locked-period actuals is preserved explicitly in the merged step's inputs.
Loading of approved budget and latest forecast is combined with actuals extraction into one automated consolidation step; both required comparatives remain explicit inputs.

Variance computation is restructured from a manual analyst calculation into an engine-driven computation with analyst oversight of policy and FX configuration; the accounting policies and constant-currency rates remain mandatory inputs per KB-06 and KB-07.

Materiality threshold application is restructured into a rules-based automated filter with analyst sign-off, preserving the function and its dual percentage/absolute threshold inputs, and remaining a distinct step from manager review to satisfy actor separation.
Obtaining budget holder commentary is unconstrained by design and is carried forward unchanged.
Consolidation and drafting of the variance report is unconstrained by design and is carried forward essentially unchanged, now drawing on the upstream consolidated dataset.

Review and challenge is preserved as a distinct function, now combined with presentation and distribution into one manager-owned step; the function survives in substance and the manager remains a different actor than whoever applied materiality thresholds, satisfying the actor-separation requirement.

Presentation and distribution to management, being unconstrained by design, is merged into the same step as review and challenge since both are owned by the FP&A manager and occur sequentially without an intervening control requirement.

steps.description: A single automated data-pipeline step pulls actuals from the locked, closed period and loads the approved budget version and latest forecast as comparatives, producing one reconciled dataset. The pipeline is configured and overseen by FP&A but the pull itself is system-executed against the locked ledger and approved planning versions, removing manual extraction risk while preserving source traceability.
steps.name: Extract and consolidate actuals, budget and forecast

steps.actor: FP&A analyst (variance analytics engine, with policy oversight)
steps.description: A variance analytics engine computes price, volume and mix variances on actuals and budget prepared on the same accounting basis, isolating the FX effect at constant currency. FP&A reviews engine configuration and policy mapping rather than performing the arithmetic manually.
steps.name: Compute price, volume and mix variances

steps.description: A rules-based threshold engine flags variances exceeding either the percentage or the absolute materiality threshold for explanation, with FP&A analyst sign-off on the flagged set before it is routed to budget holders. This step remains distinct from, and performed by a different actor than, the subsequent manager review.
steps.name: Apply materiality thresholds

steps.description: Accountable budget holders provide commentary on the selected variances, unchanged from the current process.
steps.name: Obtain commentary from budget holders

steps.description: Variances and commentary are consolidated into a draft variance report, largely unchanged from the current process but drawing on the consolidated dataset produced upstream.
steps.name: Consolidate and draft variance report

steps.description: The FP&A manager reviews and challenges the draft report and its commentary, then presents and distributes the finalised report to management. Presentation and distribution are folded into the same manager-owned step since they are not separately constrained, while the review-and-challenge function is preserved intact and performed by an actor distinct from whoever applied the materiality thresholds upstream.
steps.name: Review, challenge, present and distribute
